messages:
Mira Patel: Morning heads-up — overnight eval CI flagged a sharp regression in the 'funnel_v2' suite for galen-7b-int4. Overall score dropped from 0.78 → 0.61 on instruction_coherence cohort. Sample bad generation attached below.

ops-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval failure detected (suite: funnel_v2) — severity: high. Ticket created #INC-847.

Sam Liu: how bad is "high"? P0?

Mira Patel: not P0 yet, but top-line metric -22% relative. Some prompts produce truncated/incoherent completions. see sample:

```
Prompt: "Summarize the legal risks of X..."
Expected: concise bullet list
Model: "galen-7b-int4"
Output: "I don't know." or repeated filler text
```

Anjali Rao: could be quant kernel update or tokenizer change. Any kernel rollouts overnight?

Devon (oncall): @infra-deploys did a small rollout to int4-kernel v2.3 at 02:12 UTC. Reverted to v2.2 at 06:05 for a different issue. Logs: rollout touched parity changes in softmax kernel.

Mira Patel: kvcache miss rate also spiked on serving logs at ~02:30. attaching quick metrics: prefix hit 0.12 -> 0.03, mean latency +18ms.

Sam Liu: ok assign owners: @Anjali Rao to investigate quant/kernel interaction, @Mira Patel to run isolated evals and gather examples. @Devon to pull deploy diff and runtime logs. I'll monitor and help with reverts.

Anjali Rao: running quick reproduce locally now. command:

```
./tools/run_eval --suite funnel_v2 --model galen-7b-int4 --seed 42 --limit 200
```

Anjali Rao: initial local run shows same failure on 6/200 examples. suspicious tokenization at short sequences.

Mira Patel: saving failing prompts to /tmp/funnel_failures_1743219.json and posting to thread.

Sam Liu: if it's tokenizer, reverting kernel won't help — check token offsets and byte-level changes in tokenizer config. @devon can you dump tokenizer checksum from prod bundle?

Devon (oncall): checksum v2: 7f4a9c, no token config changed in bundle, but deploy touched fused-attn kernel. I'll attach diff.

Anjali Rao: next step — run eval with quantized fallback (int8) to see if behavior persists. Mira, can you queue quick run on dedicated infra?

Mira Patel: queued int8 fallback run on dedicated pool. ETA ~10m.

ops-bot: Job queued: eval-1743219876-int8-fallback (owner: Mira Patel)

Mira Patel: quick results: int8 run passes baseline (0.77). looks like int4 path regressed.

Sam Liu: good signal. prioritize rollback of int4 kernel or pin model to int8 until root cause identified. Reassign: @Devon do rollback of current kernel on canary; @Anjali and @Mira continue root cause. Update back here when rollback done.

Devon (oncall): rollback initiated on canary at 07:02 UTC.

Mira Patel: noted. I'll collect more examples and attach a minimal repro. Planning short postmortem if rollback doesn't fix prod within 30m.

Anjali Rao: taking lead on root cause. will report findings in 1h or earlier if blocking.

Sam Liu: thanks team. @ops-bot please keep ticket open and tag owners: Anjali, Mira, Devon.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-847 updated: owners Anjali Rao, Mira Patel, Devon (oncall). Status: investigating.

Mira Patel: logging final note to thread — initial severity: high, owners assigned, mitigations: int8 fallback ok + rollback started. I'll post follow-up with repro and logs.
